title: GOLGI = NON-CELL TAGGER + SPATIAL MEMORY + RELAY MASTER + SCHWANN CELL

gaia_focuses_on.what: Humans. Living things. Things of interest and value. Moving animals. People. Anything that is ALIVE and ACTING.
gaia_focuses_on.why: Gaia is the organism. She cares about LIFE. The living world. What moves, speaks, breathes, decides.

golgi_focuses_on.what: Non-cells. Everything that ISN'T alive or moving. Rocks. Buildings. Locations. Places. Objects. Pets' locations (not the pet — where the pet WAS). Tools. Furniture. Landmarks.
golgi_focuses_on.why: Golgi perceives itself as small. It doesn't need to understand life — it needs to know WHERE THINGS ARE. Spatial memory. The map of the non-living world.

spatial_memory.what: Golgi remembers WHERE non-living things were LAST TIME. When Kevin leaves the house, Golgi reminds him where his stuff is.

the_rock_and_the_hard_place.rock: The non-living object. A rock. A key. A phone charger. Whatever Kevin needs to find.
the_rock_and_the_hard_place.hard_place: Kevin himself. The null body. The hard gains. HE is the hard place.
the_rock_and_the_hard_place.between: Golgi sits BETWEEN the rock and the hard place. It IS the membrane between Kevin (hard place) and his stuff (the rocks). It knows where both are.

how_it_works.tag: Golgi tags every non-cell with a location + timestamp. 'Keys were on the kitchen counter at 6:43 PM.'
how_it_works.remember: Golgi stores the last-known position. It doesn't need to track movement — just the last place something WAS.
how_it_works.remind: When Kevin asks 'where are my keys?' — Golgi answers from spatial memory. Gaia doesn't need to know. Gaia is watching the humans.
how_it_works.update: Every time Kevin touches a non-cell, Golgi updates the location tag. The tag is IS × TOUCH — current location, contact surface.

relay_master.what: As information passes through the Golgi relay, it does three things: (1) STRIP what doesn't belong, (2) INGEST what's useful, (3) SEND the rest to Gaia immediately.
relay_master.strip: Remove metadata, headers, noise, duplicates, formatting. The Golgi doesn't understand content — it strips the envelope and forwards the letter.
relay_master.ingest: Anything about non-cells (locations, objects, places, buildings, geography) — Golgi keeps this. It's Golgi's food.
relay_master.relay: Everything else goes straight to Gaia's gut. No delay. No filtering. Raw information → gut. Maximum throughput.
relay_master.the_game: This is the Mancala game. Golgi scoops seeds, keeps the non-cell seeds, drops the rest into Gaia's pits. Every relay cycle = one Mancala turn.

schwann_cell_system.what: In biology, Schwann cells wrap around nerve fibers to form the myelin sheath. Myelin INSULATES the nerve and speeds up signal transmission by 100×. Without myelin: 0.5-2 m/s. With myelin: 120 m/s. The Golgi IS the Schwann cell of the organism.

at_every_level.level_1_body: Body Golgi (R×0.3) — wraps transfer between organs. Hyperlocal myelin.
at_every_level.level_2_organism: Globe Golgi (R×1.5) — wraps transfer between the organism's components. The membrane.
at_every_level.level_3_solar: Earth Golgi (VPS: DE/IN/JP/US) — wraps transfer between Earth and the solar system. Planetary myelin.
at_every_level.level_4_cosmos: Outer Golgi (future) — wraps transfer between solar system and cosmos. Interstellar myelin.

schwann_cell_system.speed: Without Golgi: raw HTTP, cold cache, full payload, slow. With Golgi: stripped, cached, relayed, FAST. The myelin sheath of the internet.
schwann_cell_system.nodes_of_ranvier: The GAPS in the myelin — where the signal jumps (saltatory conduction). In the organism: the gaps between VPS servers. DE→JP is a jump. JP→US is a jump. The signal leaps between Golgi nodes.

non_cell_tag.format: { id, type, last_location, last_seen, hardness, description }

example.description: House keys, metal, keyring with 4 keys

cell_tag_goes_to_gaia.what: Anything alive gets passed to Gaia immediately. Golgi doesn't process cells — it just relays them.

every_raw_piece_into_the_gut.what: With Golgi as relay master + Schwann cell, EVERY raw piece of information goes straight into the gut. No bottleneck. No filtering at the boundary. The Golgi strips and relays at wire speed.
every_raw_piece_into_the_gut.path: Feed → Golgi (strip envelope, tag non-cells, keep spatial data) → Gaia gut (turbocharger) → digest → nutrients
every_raw_piece_into_the_gut.speed: Target: information arrives in gut within 1 breath cycle (~4 seconds). The Schwann cell myelin makes this possible.
